domains.title: Customer Service & Support Domain
domains.purpose: This domain is the system of record for support work and outcomes, not for product configuration truth, transaction truth, or customer identity truth.

owns: Customer communication in the context of a case
Case records, complaint records, and their lifecycle state
Resolution notes and references to authoritative actions taken

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer master, user identity, group hierarchy
Customer master, user identity, group hierarchy
Merchant configuration (locations, enablement, terminal sharing groups)
Cross-domain workflow engines (investigations, broader exceptions) (if kept separate)

domains.title: Digital Channels & Experience Domain
domains.purpose: This domain owns the experience layer and channel behaviour, not the underlying product truth. It should be thin, API-driven, and orchestration-focused to support platformisation and reuse.

owns: Journey configuration and feature flag state

not_authoritative_for.content: Authentication/identity master and RBAC truth (experience consumes)
Authentication/identity master and RBAC truth (experience consumes)

domains.title: Payments Channels Domain
domains.purpose: This domain owns checkout/session lifecycle, channel runtime behaviour, device/app channel configuration at runtime, and request shaping/validation. It is the execution layer that bridges merchant configuration and downstream processing. It does not own transaction truth , merchant configuration truth , or settlement logic.

owns: Channel configuration consumption and effective runtime binding
SDK/version registry and channel capability matrices
Validation outcomes and request shaping artefacts

not_authoritative_for.content: Merchant configuration truth (locations, enablement, terminal sharing groups, MIDs)
Fraud scoring and allow/deny policy (channels may invoke, not own)
Scheme fee records and commercial pricing policy
Customer identity master and access relationships
Customer identity master and access relationships
Customer-facing “portal” experience composition (if kept separate; payments channels are acceptance surfaces)

domains.title: Customer Domain
domains.purpose: Provide Tyro’s authoritative capability for mastering real-world parties and their relationships so Tyro can maintain a single system of record for customers across products and services. This domain is authoritative for party identity and relationships, not for authentication credentials, sessions/tokens, or low-level access control policy evaluation.

owns: Manage party identity resolution and linking
Maintain customer relationship lifecycle status and derived restriction flags
Publish canonical party/relationship events for downstream consumers
Provide party/relationship query services for channels and operational domains
Provide authoritative business access grant intent for User & Identity to materialise into enforceable entitlements
Party relationships, roles, and effective dating
Customer relationship status and relationship lifecycle metadata
Business access grant intent records and audit metadata

not_authoritative_for.content: Authentication, credentials, MFA, identity provider linkage; Authorisation policy evaluation, token/session lifecycle, API keys/service principals
Commercial agreements, partner contracts, referral program lifecycle
Product-specific lifecycle status (merchant acquiring, accounts, loans, subscriptions)
AML/KYC/CDD decision outcomes, customer risk ratings, monitoring alerts

domains.title: User & Identity Domain
domains.purpose: Provide Tyro’s authoritative capability for managing system identities and enforcing access through authentication and authorisation controls across customer, partner, and staff channels. This domain is authoritative for system accounts and access control metadata, not for real-world party relationships or customer master identity.

owns: User accounts and service principals and their lifecycle status
Authentication method metadata and identity provider linkage records
Roles, scopes, policies, bindings, and derived entitlement claims
Access governance audit logs and security telemetry

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer, person, group, partner party master data and relationships; Business meaning of roles (director, beneficial owner, authorised representative)
Commercial partner agreements and program lifecycle

domains.title: Payments Product Domain
domains.purpose: Own Tyro’s merchant acquiring product as a coherent offering across channels , by defining the product-level rules, entitlements, and lifecycle that sit above merchant configuration and below commercial pricing. It provides the authoritative “product view” for acquiring—what capabilities exist, how they’re packaged, and which features apply to which customer cohort—without becoming a system-of-record for transactions or balances.

owns: Payments product definition and lifecycle policy
References to pricing plan IDs / offer constructs

not_authoritative_for.content: Merchant-specific configuration (MerchantID, locations, terminal sharing groups, enablement flags)
Transaction truth (authorisation, clearing, chargebacks); Scheme/network fee calculation
Merchant payout calculation and settlement batches
Commercial fee rules and pricing calculations
Customer master identity and access model
Customer master identity and access model

domains.title: Payments Customer Configuration Domain
domains.purpose: Maintain the authoritative configuration for how a specific customer is set up to accept payments across Tyro’s acquiring channels . This domain is the “control plane” for acquiring: it defines the merchant’s operational setup that downstream runtime and processing domains must follow. This domain is merchant-specific configuration truth. It does not run checkout sessions, does not own transaction truth, does not calculate payouts, and does not own commercial pricing rules.

owns: Channel enablement state and acceptance parameters

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer legal entity master, users, groups/franchises
Customer legal entity master, users, groups/franchises
Transaction truth (authorisation, clearing, disputes); Scheme/network fee records
Commercial pricing rules/fee calculation (Tyro fees, discounts, commissions)
Settlement batch formation and net payout calculation
Partner technical certification and conformance state

domains.title: Payments Processing Domain
domains.purpose: Process acquiring card payments from authorisation to clearing, and maintain the authoritative “transaction truth” required for reliable merchant acquiring operations. It is the system of record for payment transaction lifecycle state and clearing evidence, not for merchant configuration, settlement calculation, disputes workflow, accounting journals, rail transfers, or banking ledgers.

owns: Transaction master record and lifecycle state
Authorisation state records and reason codes
Processing lifecycle audit trail and correlation metadata

not_authoritative_for.content: Merchant configuration, enablement, terminal sharing groups
Checkout session UX and terminal/app runtime orchestration
AML/CTF monitoring, sanctions screening, regulatory reporting
Commercial pricing and fee rules (Tyro fees/discounts/commissions)
Dispute/chargeback case lifecycle (stages, deadlines, representment, outcomes)
Merchant payout calculation and settlement batches
Payments sub-ledger journals, control accounts, accounting balances

domains.title: Settlement & Reconciliation Domain
domains.purpose: Aggregate cleared acquiring transactions, apply fees/adjustments, and produce the authoritative calculation of what Tyro owes each merchant , including settlement batch formation and reconciliation controls. …and to provide reproducible, auditable settlement outcomes suitable for a regulated environment. It is the system of record for merchant settlement calculations, not for executing transfers , not for maintaining the bank ledger , and not for maintaining payments accounting journals/control accounts .

owns: Settlement batches and settlement line items
Fee allocation and adjustment records as applied in settlement
Merchant payable balances and hold state
Reconciliation control totals and variance records
Links between settlement outcomes and transfer execution references

not_authoritative_for.content: Commercial pricing policy and fee rule definitions (Settlement consumes pricing outputs/fees; it does not define the rules.)
Payments sub-ledger journals, control accounts, accounting balances
Customer identity master and merchant configuration truth
Customer identity master and merchant configuration truth
Customer identity master and merchant configuration truth
Regulatory compliance posture and decisions (Settlement enforces holds, but compliance owns the compliance decision.)
Case workflow lifecycle for investigation (Settlement raises breaks; Case domain manages investigation workflow.)

domains.title: Payments Accounting Domain
domains.scope_note: Called acquirer-specific: the payments sub-ledger. Distinct from the tyro-wide Accounting Product Domain.
domains.purpose: This domain is the system of record for operational accounting entries and balances for the Payments product. It consumes authoritative source events from Payments Processing, Settlement & Reconciliation, and Product Quoting & Pricing and produces auditable double-entry accounting representations.

owns: Generate and post payments sub-ledger journals from authoritative events
Maintain payments sub-ledger account structures and GL mapping rules
Manage reversals, corrections, and controlled adjustments with approvals and audit metadata
Maintain operational trial balance and control account positions
Reconcile accounting control positions to operational sources
Produce reconciled GL export feeds/batches to Corporate Finance and track downstream acknowledgements
Support audit evidence retrieval for any entry or balance
Payments sub-ledger journals and journal lines
Payments sub-ledger chart of accounts and account metadata
Mappings from payments sub-ledger accounts to corporate GL
Payments accounting balances, trial balances, and control account positions
GL export batch records and export/reconciliation status

not_authoritative_for.content: Transaction truth, clearing lifecycle, scheme chargebacks/disputes lifecycle
Settlement obligation calculation, settlement batching, payout composition (the “what we owe merchants” computation)
Pricing plans, fee rules, discounts, commissions policy and fee calculation logic
Invoicing, AR balances, collections, credit notes, ageing
Execution of money movement (rail instruction lifecycle/outcomes)
Customer master, user identity, group hierarchy
Customer master, user identity, group hierarchy
Bank ledger entries and regulated account balances/statements (Banking Ledger)
Statutory GL, external financial reporting, corporate close ownership

domains.title: Hardware & Asset Management Domain
domains.scope_note: Called acquirer-specific: the managed hardware estate is payment terminals today. Revisit if non-payment assets are brought in.
domains.purpose: Manage Tyro’s physical payment hardware assets across their lifecycle — procurement to disposal — ensuring we have a canonical record of what devices exist, who owns them, where they are, and their compliance/servicing status. This domain is the system of record for physical assets, not runtime behaviour.

owns: Asset registry and asset lifecycle state

not_authoritative_for.content: Firmware versions and OTA updates; Runtime device configuration (payment params, UI settings)

domains.title: Terminal Fleet & Device Management Domain
domains.purpose: This domain ensures terminals are secure, up to date, correctly configured, and observable — without owning financial transaction truth.

owns: Device provisioning/registration into Tyro fleet systems
OTA firmware/software distribution and rollout governance
Fleet observability and device health state management
Firmware versions, rollout plans/cohorts, rollout outcomes

not_authoritative_for.content: Merchant configuration truth (e.g., which MerchantIDs, terminal sharing groups, enablement rules)
Checkout session lifecycle and terminal UX flows

domains.title: Deposits Product Domain
domains.purpose: This domain is the system of record for deposit account truth, while still separating policy and customer configuration concerns to keep the ledger clean and stable.

owns: Account records, ledger entries, balances, term deposits, statements
Banking audit trail for account/config changes

not_authoritative_for.content: Partner consent and external workflow orchestration
Merchant payout calculation and settlement batches
Customer identity master and group hierarchy
Customer identity master and group hierarchy

domains.title: Lending Product Domain
domains.purpose: This domain is the system of record for loan lifecycle and servicing truth, while keeping product policy and customer configuration distinct from contract/sub-ledger truth.

owns: Lending product policy definitions and versions
Loan contracts, schedules, sub-ledger balances, allocation records, servicing state
Lending audit trail for changes within domain scope

not_authoritative_for.content: Credit approval/decline and risk grade truth
Commercial pricing and fee rule calculation
Customer identity master and group hierarchy
Customer identity master and group hierarchy

domains.title: Credit & Underwriting Domain
domains.purpose: This domain is the authoritative source for credit decision truth, while the Lending Product domain owns loan contract lifecycle and repayment obligations.

owns: Integration orchestration for credit inputs as assessment inputs
Decision issuance with conditions, limits, and reason codes
Credit decision audit trail and reporting
Credit scoring outputs and reason codes

not_authoritative_for.content: Loan contract, repayment schedule, outstanding principal
Commercial pricing policy (general) (credit may produce risk grade used as an input/reference)

domains.title: Accounting Product Domain
domains.purpose: This domain exists to deliver a “merchant CFO/finance OS” layer that can integrate with Tyro product data but remains distinct from Tyro’s corporate accounting and from regulated banking ledgers.

owns: Merchant journal entries and accounting period state

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer legal entity master and identity
Customer legal entity master and identity
Merchant acquiring configuration (MID, locations, terminal sharing groups)
External accounting platform integrations consent/workflows (if applicable)

domains.title: Funds Movement Domain
domains.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: rail execution (BECS/NPP/RTGS) serves banking payouts and merchant settlement alike, though merchant settlement is its highest-volume caller.
domains.purpose: This domain is the authoritative source for transfer execution state, not the source of “why” a payment is being made, and not the ledger of balances .

owns: Status tracking, retries , and reconciliation of rail responses
Transfer instruction records and execution status history
Return codes, failure reasons, settlement/confirmation timestamps

not_authoritative_for.content: Settlement batch calculation and payable balances
Customer-facing notifications (Funds Movement emits events; notifications decide what to send)

domains.title: Billing & Accounts Receivable Domain
domains.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: bills every Tyro product, though merchant fee recovery in the acquiring flow is a large share of it.
domains.purpose: Manage what customers owe Tyro by owning the authoritative lifecycle for billing accounts, invoice generation and issuance, and accounts-receivable balances, aging, and collections, kept separate from transaction settlement, the banking ledger, and corporate GL.

owns: AR balances, aging, payment allocation records

not_authoritative_for.content: Regulated bank ledger and customer bank account balances
Transfer execution (direct debit/collections rails) (Billing requests collection; Funds Movement executes)

domains.title: Customer Acquisition Domain
domains.purpose: Manage Tyro’s go-to-market engine from market engagement through to a qualified, accepted opportunity and a clean handoff into Customer & Product Onboarding. It does not own customer identity truth, product activation truth, merchant configuration truth, or pricing rule truth.

owns: Handoff orchestration to Customer & Product Onboarding
Campaign records, attribution metadata, and growth experiments
Opportunity records and pipeline stage truth
Sales activity timeline and engagement artefacts
Handoff package metadata and growth-side handoff status

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer legal entity master, users, groups/franchises
Customer legal entity master, users, groups/franchises; Consent/preference master, if centralised (Growth consumes)
Application workflow state machine & activation sequencing
Merchant configuration (MIDs, locations, terminal sharing groups)
Authoritative pricing rules, fee calculation, commissions policy

domains.title: Partnerships Domain
domains.purpose: Maintain the authoritative record and lifecycle for all third-party organisations Tyro engages with as partners, and govern how those partners participate in Tyro’s go-to-market and product ecosystem. It owns the commercial relationship, not the technical integration and not the customer identity model.

owns: Partner master record and lifecycle state

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer legal entity master & group/franchise hierarchy
Customer legal entity master & group/franchise hierarchy
Technical integration specs and runtime connectivity
Technical integration specs and runtime connectivity
Technical integration specs and runtime connectivity
Merchant configuration to enable a partner’s service (+ VAS enablement where relevant)

domains.title: Groups & Enterprises Domain
domains.purpose: Manage the policies, control structures, and governance rules required to support enterprise and franchise operating models where multiple customer legal entities operate under a shared umbrella . It is authoritative for group governance and policy, not for customer identity master, merchant configuration truth, transaction truth, settlement balances, or pricing engine calculation.

owns: Group governance policy records and versions
Group-level operational policy baselines and exceptions
Settlement routing and fee carve-out policy definitions

not_authoritative_for.content: Group/franchise membership and hierarchy identity (GroupID + membership)
User identities and access enforcement (RBAC; this domain only defines delegation policy)
Merchant configuration records (locations, enablement, terminal sharing groups)
Settlement batch computation and merchant balances
Commercial fee calculation and rate engine
Bank ledger balances / regulated account state

domains.title: Corporate Finance Domain
domains.purpose: Maintain Tyro's corporate general ledger, accounting periods and close processes, and statutory/management financial reporting as the authoritative source, kept separate from product/customer financial truth such as merchant settlements and banking ledgers.

owns: Corporate financial statements and reporting artefacts
Corporate reconciliation status metadata and evidence references

not_authoritative_for.content: Merchant settlement balances and payout truth
Banking deposit ledger entries and balances
Enterprise analytics and derived reporting datasets
Enterprise analytics and derived reporting datasets
Enterprise analytics and derived reporting datasets

domains.title: Risk, Compliance & Regulatory Domain
domains.purpose: Provide Tyro’s authoritative capability for managing regulatory obligations and compliance controls across the customer lifecycle , ensuring Tyro can operate as a regulated Australian business bank with auditable adherence to applicable regulatory requirements. Operational domains remain authoritative for transaction truth, product lifecycles, and ledger truth. This domain is authoritative for regulatory policy execution and outcomes.

owns: Monitoring alerts and dispositions and their audit metadata
Restriction/condition directives and time-bound enforcement instructions
Regulatory reporting artefacts metadata and evidence references
Control operation evidence, attestations, exceptions/waivers, and audit trail metadata

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer/party master identity, legal entity/person records, and user access control (this domain stores references to identity evidence; it does not master identity)
Customer/party master identity, legal entity/person records, and user access control (this domain stores references to identity evidence; it does not master identity)
Onboarding/origination journey state and product activation orchestration (and relevant servicing/orchestration domains)
Settlement obligation calculation and payout truth
Investigation case workflow tooling and queues (this domain triggers/escalates cases and provides decisions/outcomes; case workflow is managed elsewhere)
Analytical data products, semantic models, and dashboards
AI/ML model lifecycle tooling and deployment operations

domains.title: Fraud & Risk Decisioning Domain
domains.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: covers banking and onboarding risk as well as card-present and CNP transaction fraud.
domains.purpose: Prevent fraud and misuse by providing a low-latency decision engine that produces operational risk outcomes used inline in product flows, primarily in acquiring payments , and optionally in adjacent areas . It does not own AML/CTF compliance monitoring, sanctions screening, or regulatory reporting .

owns: Operational fraud policy definitions and versions

not_authoritative_for.content: AML/CTF monitoring, sanctions screening, regulatory reporting
Merchant configuration truth (incl. terminal sharing groups)

domains.title: Disputes & Recovery Domain
domains.scope_note: Called acquirer-specific: scheme chargebacks and recovery. Banking disputes would widen this.
domains.purpose: Manage disputes arising from payments acquiring across two coupled workflows: scheme-managed dispute progression (chargebacks, retrieval requests, representment) and Tyro's own economic recovery, publishing authoritative scheme and recovery outcomes to downstream consumers.

owns: Dispute case master record and scheme-managed lifecycle truth
Evidence coordination references and deadline/SLA artefacts
FinancialCommitment intents and their lineage to dispute cases/outcomes
Operational audit trails and correlation metadata

not_authoritative_for.content: Transaction master record, authorisation state; Scheme clearing ingestion & clearing truth (incl. clearing adjustments as records)
Merchant payout calculation, settlement batches, merchant payable balances, application of debits/credits
Payment GL journals and statutory books
Commercial pricing plans / product fee rules (Disputes may *trigger* fee commitments; it does not own fee plan policy.)
Fraud policy ownership / risk decision policy

domains.title: Payments VAS Integrations Domain
domains.purpose: Enable and operate value-added services that are invoked within the acquiring payment flow , by integrating Tyro’s acceptance and payment flows with approved third-party providers. It is authoritative for VAS invocation, provider abstraction, and VAS outcomes—not for transaction truth.

owns: VAS invocation orchestration: when to call a provider; request/response choreography; timeouts/retries/fallback policies
Provider abstraction layer: mapping canonical ↔ provider protocols; adapter versioning
Merchant-level VAS enablement: enable/disable per merchant/channel/device; validate config; routing to provider
Operational resilience controls: circuit breakers; degradation; alerting triggers for provider failure
VAS outcome normalisation: standardised outcomes surfaced to Runtime/Support tooling
VAS invocation outcomes and telemetry state
Provider health state and operational control flags

domains.title: POS Integration Domain
domains.purpose: Define and operate the POS integration surface for Tyro acquiring so POS vendors can initiate and manage payment flows reliably and consistently across supported channels . This domain owns the technical integration model for POS → Tyro , not the commercial partnership and not cross-ecosystem certification governance.

owns: POS flow orchestration at the integration edge
Reference implementations / sample apps / SDKs specifically for POS integration
Technical troubleshooting patterns and diagnostics hooks for POS flows
POS integration specs and versioned contracts
POS integration configuration metadata required to operate the integration surface

domains.title: Banking VAS Integrations Domain
domains.purpose: This domain exists to keep the regulated Banking ledger clean and stable while allowing external ecosystem services to plug in modularly. It owns the consent model and partner-facing orchestration of banking workflows—not ledger truth or rail execution.

owns: Banking workflow orchestration state and execution logs
Provider capability registry and mapping configuration metadata
Provider health state and operational control flags

not_authoritative_for.content: Transfer execution on rails (NPP/BECS/internal), return codes
Partner commercial contract and lifecycle (as a partner)
Integration certification lifecycle and conformance evidence
Customer legal entity master, users, group hierarchy
Customer legal entity master, users, group hierarchy
Customer-facing UX composition (this domain supplies APIs/events; channels render)

domains.title: Partner Developer Experience Domain
domains.purpose: It exists to prevent partner experience and tooling from fragmenting across product-specific integration domains. This domain is authoritative for the experience and tooling layer of partner development—not the product integration specifications, not certification decisions, and not partner commercial lifecycle.

owns: Developer portal catalogue metadata and documentation publishing state
Sandbox tenancy records and sandbox state
Credential lifecycle metadata and audit logs
Developer-facing change notice and distribution logs

not_authoritative_for.content: Certification lifecycle, conformance evidence, production eligibility
POS integration specifications and runtime connectivity
Payment acceptance runtime and checkout session state
Merchant-specific acquiring configuration (MIDs, enablement, terminal sharing groups)
Customer identity master and access model (DevEx consumes identity/auth patterns, doesn’t own them)
Customer identity master and access model (DevEx consumes identity/auth patterns, doesn’t own them)

domains.title: Integration Enablement & Certification Domain
domains.scope_note: Called acquirer-specific: scheme and device certification dominate. Partner API enablement leans tyro-wide.
domains.purpose: This domain owns the certification lifecycle and conformance truth: what is certified, for which versions, with what scope, and whether it is production-eligible.

owns: Test plan orchestration and certification decisioning
Version compatibility governance and re-certification triggers
Test suite catalog and required mapping per surface/type
Compatibility matrix and support policy for certified versions

domains.title: Enterprise Data Governance Domain
domains.purpose: Provide Tyro’s enterprise-wide data governance, assurance, and control framework so data across domains is trusted, secure, compliant, and reusable — without owning operational business truth or regulatory policy. Risk & Compliance domains remain responsible for regulatory interpretation and policy setting. Enterprise Data Governance enables compliance to those policies through defined data standards and control frameworks.

owns: Establish enterprise data ownership and stewardship model
Define glossary operating model and semantic lifecycle governance
Define classification, access, retention and handling standards
Define CDE frameworks aligned to regulatory obligations
Define and govern data contract framework
Define minimum lineage and metadata standards
Provide assurance processes and certification reviews
Govern lifecycle of certified cross-domain metrics
Data contract standards and registry metadata
Data quality policy definitions and assurance artefacts

not_authoritative_for.content: Authoritative business semantics; systems of record
Data pipeline implementation; analytical marts and dashboards

domains.title: Data Analytics & Intelligence Domain
domains.purpose: Provide Tyro’s technical foundation and operational capability to ingest, transform, store, and serve data as trusted, reusable data products — enabling analytics and cross-domain insights while not owning operational master truth. Operational domains remain authoritative for business invariants.

owns: Curated analytical data products and SLAs
Cross-domain derived datasets and activation artefacts

domains.title: AI & ML Domain
domains.purpose: Productionise AI and ML capabilities safely and reliably across Tyro by providing shared lifecycle tooling, operational controls, and governance mechanisms — while keeping business decision authority in relevant domains. This capability is the system of record for AI/ML operational artefacts — not for business decision policy.

owns: AI/ML operational runbooks and incident response

domains.title: Customer & Product Onboarding
domains.purpose: Orchestrate the end-to-end process from prospect → application → assessment → approval → product activation across one or more products . Owns the application workflow state machine and sequencing, while delegating decisions and record creation to authoritative domains.

owns: Application lifecycle state machine and orchestration rules
Sequencing and idempotent activation coordination across domains
Handoff/return loops for missing info and manual review

domains.title: Customer Lifecycle Management
domains.purpose: Coordinate lifecycle transitions for active customers/products , such as suspension, reactivation, upgrades/downgrades, product add-ons, and offboarding. Ensures lifecycle policies are applied consistently across multiple product domains without embedding cross-domain workflow logic inside them.

owns: Cross-product lifecycle state machine and orchestration rules
Controlled execution of suspend/reactivate/offboard across products
Coordination of “product add-on” lifecycle where multiple domains must act
Emission of lifecycle events and tracking of completion/partial failure handling
Lifecycle workflow state and execution logs
Lifecycle reason codes and policy references

domains.title: Product Bundling & Eligibility
domains.purpose: Define and orchestrate how Tyro sells and manages multi-product bundles , including eligibility checks, bundle composition rules, and cross-product activation coordination. This prevents bundling logic being scattered across product domains and sales tools.

domains.title: Product Quoting & Pricing
domains.scope_note: Called tyro-wide: prices all products, though acquiring MSF / interchange-plus pricing is its most complex case.
domains.purpose: Define, govern, and apply Tyro’s commercial revenue logic across products and channels—so pricing, fees, revenue share, and commissions are consistent, versioned, auditable, and reusable across Payments, Banking, Lending, Financial Management, and partner-led propositions. It is authoritative for commercial policy and calculation, not for scheme fees, ledger entries, invoicing, or settlement.

owns: Rate cards, fee rules, and applicability/eligibility policies
Partner commission and revenue-share rule definitions
Pricing decision outputs and fee breakdowns

not_authoritative_for.content: Scheme/network fees and clearing-level fees; Transaction truth and volumes (Revenue consumes as input)
Deposit ledger balances and interest accrual
Group/franchise hierarchy (and policy specifics may sit in Groups & Enterprises )
Group/franchise hierarchy (and policy specifics may sit in Groups & Enterprises )

domains.title: Operational Case Management
domains.purpose: A shared and generic enterprise capability for operational case management, investigations, evidence handling, and exception workflow orchestration across multiple domains. Manage cross-domain operational exceptions and investigations that require multi-team workflows, evidence, and audit trails—such as reconciliation breaks, disputes coordination, compliance investigations, fraud escalations, and complex operational incidents. This domain owns the workflow of exceptions, not the underlying product records.

owns: Multi-team task orchestration and decision logging
Case records, workflow state, task state

domains.title: Customer Notifications & Communications
domains.purpose: Decide what communications to send, when, and through which channel, based on events from authoritative domains—ensuring regulated communications are compliant, templates are managed, delivery is tracked, and customer communication logic isn’t duplicated across product systems.

owns: Opt-in/opt-out enforcement by consuming preference sources
Template metadata references and dispatch records

not_authoritative_for.content: Customer identity and preferences master (or dedicated preferences capability, if created)
Customer identity and preferences master (or dedicated preferences capability, if created)
In-app UX presentation (this domain triggers; channels render)
